svg.aria-label: Basement finish plan, redrawn from a hand sketch
svg.title: Basement finish plan, redrawn from a hand sketch
svg.text: Stair, about 3′-6″ wide. The arrow is copied from
the sketch, which does not label it.
Landing, 45″ clear, with a glass door into the office
and a 12″ wall stub beside the stair.
Door from the office into the storage.
Storage, with the electrical sub panel on the outside wall.
Ejector pit for the bathroom’s sewage pump, in a 3′ bay
off the storage (“eject. crock” on the sketch).
shower’s single line is read as glass.
Bathroom door from the open space, set across the
HVAC closet with a pair of bi-fold doors.
Mechanical closet (“water” on the sketch), about 10′ long,
two pairs of bi-fold doors. From the south end: WT the well’s
pressure tank, WH water heater, IF iron filter, B brine tank,
S softener. UV light on the wall behind the last three.
Double door in the outside wall, 6′ as drawn.
Windows in the south wall, drawn full size (3′ × 4′; the sketch
gives no sizes): one as sketched, one added, position assumed.
The two the sketch has in the east wall are removed.
Sump pit on the perimeter drain, and a small unlabelled
Line of the beam above, dashed, with three posts drawn
Pocket door between the office and the bathroom, drawn
on the sketch as a thinner length of wall.
Fireplace, not on the sketch, centred on the open space’s east
wall where its windows were: a 5′ chase and hearth, size assumed.
Redrawn from a photograph of a hand sketch, then revised with the
owner’s corrections; items 13, 16 and 17 say what differs from it.
Dimensions in upright type are the sketch’s own; italic ones are
derived from them or scaled from the photo. Exterior walls are drawn
8″ thick and partitions 4½″; the sketch gives no thicknesses. Its
dimensions run to the outside of the foundation. Not field-verified.
Drawing 2 of 3 · redrawn from the sketch in drawing 1, revised after the owner’s review · October 2026
drawn by Claude, from a sketch supplied by Bowie Smith
scale: see bar · sheet directions only, no north arrow on the sketch
